claim: The Oriole userspace can identify the supported front/ultra-wide camera topology without treating the unsupported GN1 path as working.
oracle: A read-only probe identifies IMX355 or IMX386 nodes, reports media topology counts and leaves frame capture as a separate gate.

user_journey.scenario: The user opens a camera tool after a normal Omarchy boot and needs to know whether a usable sensor is present.
user_journey.expected: The user sees a supported sensor or a clear topology failure; the probe does not hang the camera pipeline or start capture.

invariants: Only sysfs video/media node names are read.
The GN1 main sensor is labelled unsupported until CSIS frame errors are fixed.
No stream, frame, sensor power transition or camera service restart occurs.
gitnexus: The package stages the probe beside the inactive camera profile and does not enable it from boot.
ast: Sensor classification is limited to IMX355, IMX386 and S5KGN1; unknown nodes remain unknown.

unit.red: The public tree had camera profile inputs but no user-facing topology check.
unit.green: Fixtures cover IMX355 success, GN1 rejection and absent media nodes.

evidence: Offline fixture passes; live supported-sensor frame capture remains pending.

limitations: Topology presence does not prove a frame can be captured.
The main GN1 camera remains intentionally unsupported in this checkpoint.
exit_gate: Run the topology probe after a cold normal boot, then perform one attended IMX355 or IMX386 preview and still capture with a watchdog and rollback path.
